sourceSummary.summary: Coordinate specialists; do not perform their work in this skill. - Execute stages in this order: intake, research, model design, computation, validation, visualization, paper, audit. - Keep one owner for every canonical artifact and return defects to that owner.

Convert raw competition materials into a precise contract for research and modeling. - Inventory every problem, template, data, and rules file before interpreting the task. - Extract text from supported documents without modifying source files.

Build a compact evidence base that supports method choice and factual claims. - Derive queries from each subproblem's domain, method family, constraints, and evaluation needs. - Search primary scholarly indexes and DOI registries through configured research tools.

Turn the problem contract and evidence base into an executable modeling contract. - Start from the decision target and data-generating structure, not from a preferred algorithm. - Compare at least two credible method families when alternatives exist.

Produce real, reproducible results for each approved subproblem. - Read the intake, model, and validation contracts before coding. - Implement subproblems in dependency order and keep their stable IDs.

Challenge accepted computations before they become paper claims. - Select checks that match the problem type rather than mechanically applying every metric. - Compare with a naive or established baseline under the same data and evaluation protocol.

Treat every figure as a scientific argument with reproducible evidence. - State the single conclusion the figure must support before choosing a chart or layout. - Map each panel to a unique evidence role; remove decorative or redundant panels.
Write the paper from approved evidence rather than from model memory. - Stage the supplied competition template and edit only the working copy. - Create a claim-evidence map before drafting prose.

Advise the paper author without becoming a second owner of the manuscript source. - Read the draft, evidence manifest, validation summary, and verified bibliography. - Write findings only to `work/03_paper/prose_polish_report.yaml`.

Act as an independent final reviewer, not as the original author. - Confirm the statement, template, source, final PDF, and all canonical contracts exist. - Reconcile stable subproblem IDs across analysis, models, results, figures, claims, and sections.
